# ITSS.asia

> ITSS (IT Support & Services) is an IT team in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, Vietnam. We provide IT helpdesk and support, office network and firewall configuration, systems administration, Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration, hardware quotes (any brand), automation and ERP, phone systems and access control, and software license review for small and foreign-owned offices. We work in English and Vietnamese. Free 30-minute office IT and network review; quotes within 1 business day.

Contact: hello@itss.asia | WhatsApp +84 908 842 096 | 15 Lê Thánh Tôn, Sài Gòn Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

## Services (English)
- [IT Helpdesk](https://itss.asia/it-helpdesk/): One point of contact for every user support request.
- [IT Support](https://itss.asia/it-support/): Remote and on-site support for PCs, email, network and printers in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi.
- [System configuration (firewall, network, Wi-Fi, VPN)](https://itss.asia/system-configuration/): Firewall, switch, Wi-Fi and VPN configured properly, with handover documents.
- [IT systems administration](https://itss.asia/it-systems-administration/): Day-to-day administration, monitoring and config backup.
- [Hardware quotes](https://itss.asia/hardware-quotes/): Quotes for IT hardware from any brand and of any type, matched to your needs.
- [Email & Workspace](https://itss.asia/email-workspace/): Administration of Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and business email.
- [Automation & ERP](https://itss.asia/automation-erp/): Power Apps, Power Automate, Lark, Misa and chatbots for internal workflows.
- [Phone systems & access control](https://itss.asia/phone-access-control/): PBX phone systems, virtual numbers and card access for offices.
- [Software license review](https://itss.asia/software-licenses/): Windows and software license review with purchasing advice.
